exposure: maternal diabetes (pre-pregnancy diabetes, gestational diabetes mellitus)
cohort: 17,027,792 mothers and their infants documented in the National Vital Statistic System in the U.S. from 2016 to 2020.
finding: While both pre-pregnancy diabetes and GDM were significantly associated with preterm birth, these associations varied by race/ethnicity, and the risk of preterm birth for GDM increased with increasing BMI in all groups, but the joint association of pre-pregnancy diabetes and BMI levels with preterm birth differed by race/ethnicity.
